business.heroText: Find and connect with independent cleaners for your listings, rooms or locations. You pay the cleaner directly, at their own business rate. Alieni never takes commission on their work.

business.how1Text: 4 short steps: account, business type, number of units, addresses. You see your monthly price before paying anything.
business.how2Text: Search cleaners near your locations or post a free job. Chat, meet, confirm the deal together.
business.how3Text: Everything done for you shows up in your monthly statement. Cancel any time.

airbnb.heroText: Paste your Airbnb, Booking.com or VRBO calendar. Every checkout becomes a cleaning slot your regular cleaner reserves weeks ahead. No more Sunday-night messages.
airbnb.example: Example: {units} listings = {fee} per month excl. VAT.
airbnb.benefit1Text: We read your bookings every 30 minutes. Turnover days become cleaning slots by themselves.
airbnb.benefit2Text: Your connected cleaner reserves slots ahead; nobody 48 hours before checkout? You get a heads-up and we offer the slot to others.
airbnb.benefit3Text: Per listing per month, no commission on the cleaning. You pay the cleaner directly.
airbnb.demoCaption: Your dashboard after linking a calendar.

hotel.heroTitle: Room turnovers handled, a few euros per room.
hotel.heroText: Link your channel manager via iCal or enter expected turnovers daily. Your cleaners see weeks ahead and mark each room done.
hotel.example: Example: {units} rooms = {fee} per month excl. VAT.
hotel.benefit1Text: A fixed price per guest room. Small B&B or 60 rooms: it scales with you.
hotel.benefit2Text: No iCal? Enter the number of turnovers per day — done in 10 seconds.
hotel.benefit3Text: Your cleaner marks each turnover done, optionally with a photo of the made-up room.
hotel.demoHeading: Hotel De Linde — turnovers this week
hotel.demoCaption: Your dashboard: iCal slots and manual turnovers side by side.

restaurant.heroTitle: Clean before the first guest. Every day.
restaurant.heroText: Post a job with your closing hours; cleaners who accept hospitality respond with their rate. You choose, meet, and confirm the deal in the app.
restaurant.example: Example: {units} location = {fee} per month excl. VAT.
restaurant.benefit1Text: Daily, weekly or one-off — before opening or after closing, you set the times.
restaurant.benefit2Text: Cleaners respond with their business hourly rate (typically €25–35). No surprises.
restaurant.benefit3Text: No commission, no contract: cancel any time at the end of the month.
restaurant.demoHeading: Brasserie Zuid — responses to your job
restaurant.demoCaption: What a posted job with responses looks like.

office.heroTitle: A regular cleaner for your office, shop or practice.
office.heroText: Describe what needs doing and when. Cleaners with a KvK number respond; after meeting you confirm the deal together. Then everything runs automatically.
office.example: Example: {units} location = {fee} per month excl. VAT.
office.benefit1Text: Every business cleaner on Alieni works with a KvK number and keeps 100% of the rate.
office.benefit2Text: One invoice at the end of the month with VAT breakdown, PDF and CSV for your bookkeeping.
office.benefit3Text: Chain of shops or several practices? Add locations; the price is per location.
office.demoHeading: Kapsalon Glans — responses to your job
office.demoCaption: What a posted job with responses looks like.

school.benefit2Text: Post jobs for after school hours or holidays and build a lasting relationship.
school.benefit3Text: One fixed price per site per month. Billed in arrears, with VAT breakdown.
